translations.web: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
translations.bsb: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
translations.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
translations.asv: For as the lightning cometh forth from the east, and is seen even unto the west; so shall be the coming of the Son of man.
